name: ANSI/IEEE Self-operating thermal switch form
aliases: IEEE Thermal Switch Normally Closed, Self-operating
summary: IEEE-library form of self-operating thermal switch: a self-operating thermal switch responds directly to its thermal condition rather than through a separate powered relay input.
description: This reference locates self-operating thermal switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented pressure and temperature switches family. A self-operating thermal switch responds directly to its thermal condition rather than through a separate powered relay input. Its contact and reset behaviour are device-specific. The public library uses HTS12S59C for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Trace the thermal device separately from any PLC or auxiliary supply. A self-operating thermal switch is not the same as a powered temperature monitoring relay. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
